data.summary: MLS 2018-2020 regular-season cycle facts complete. 1091 fixtures x 5 fields = 5455 rows. meeting_number/return_leg/official_round ok (3273); second_cycle/matchday unavailable (2182) — no double round robin exists in any of the three seasons, MLS publishes no numbered matchdays.

season_rules.definition: Unbalanced schedule: 23 teams, 34 games each. Full double round robin would require 44 games per team. Pairs met 1-3 times (104 pairs twice, 132 once, 17 pairs three times).
season_rules.expected_schedule_rule: Home-and-away vs most conference opponents plus selected cross-conference opponents; 17 pairs (rivalries/additional) met a third time.
season_rules.cycle_route_note: No defined competition cycles; cycle_route not applicable.

season_rules.definition: Unbalanced schedule: 24 teams (12 East + 12 West), 34 games each. Full double round robin would require 46 games per team. All 132 intra-conference pairs met exactly twice (home and away); all 144 cross-conference pairs met exactly once.
season_rules.expected_schedule_rule: Home-and-away vs each of 11 conference opponents (22 games) + single game vs each of 12 cross-conference opponents (12 games) = 34.
season_rules.cycle_route_note: No defined competition cycles; cycle_route not applicable.

season_rules.definition: COVID-shortened regionalized unbalanced schedule: 26 teams, 18-23 games each (mode 23). Full double round robin would require 50 games per team. Pairs met 1-4 times (62 once, 48 twice, 22 three times, 17 four times; 4-meeting pairs are regional rivalries). Includes 36 MLS is Back Tournament group-stage games which counted toward regular-season standings; excludes 15 MIBT knockout games and 17 playoff games.
season_rules.expected_schedule_rule: Pre-shutdown (2 games/team) + MIBT group stage (3 games/team, counted as regular season) + regionalized resume schedule (Aug 12-Nov 8); no balanced home-away structure.
season_rules.cycle_route_note: No defined competition cycles; cycle_route not applicable.

key_findings: double_round_robin=false for 2018, 2019, 2020 (unbalanced schedules; 2020 COVID-shortened). No cycle boundary exists; supports_second_cycle_mapping=false.
2018: 391 fixtures, 23 teams x 34 games; pairs met 1-3x (17 pairs x3, e.g. NYCFC-Orlando).
2019: 408 fixtures, 24 teams x 34 games; clean: 132 intra-conference pairs x2 (home/away), 144 cross-conference pairs x1.
2020: 292 fixtures, 26 teams, 18-23 games each; includes 36 MLS is Back group-stage games (counted in regular-season standings); excludes 15 MIBT knockout + 17 playoff games.
meeting_number derived chronologically per pair from complete schedule (field_semantics=derived_from_complete_source_schedule).
return_leg=true iff venue reversed vs pair's immediately previous meeting.
matchday unavailable: MLS publishes no numbered matchdays; fbref has no matchday column.

Caveat: worldfootball.net fetch failed; fbref used for round-label verification (Regular Season vs Playoffs/MIBT boundaries verified). football-data dates appear ~1 day timezone-shifted vs US-local; chronological order internally consistent.
